method: Read actual evaluated source triangles and actual native GLB node hierarchy. Finite independent void-path grids and blocked structural controls compare triangle intersections with declared convex compounds. Joins use closed-solid winding plus exact point-to-triangle distance. Marker metadata does not replace live native transforms.
limits: Finite component geometry probes, not continuous collision error certification, engine physics, service procedure, electrical operation, universal actor fit or installed-room testing.
Small switch/retainer ornaments are not separately simulated. No moving parts or animations are claimed in these static components.
